orchestrator.name: beeguard-lab
orchestrator.description: An agentic lab that travels back to the year 2000, reads only the chemistry known by then, and re-discovers the bee-safe insecticides science would not confirm for another two decades. Specialist agents hand work to each other, a human approves every experiment, and the result rewrites what runs next.

specialists.name: literature
specialists.description: Searches live scientific sources and files citable evidence cards.

specialists.name: insight
specialists.description: Turns evidence cards into one falsifiable hypothesis.

specialists.name: planner
specialists.description: Compares candidate experiments and chooses which one runs.

specialists.name: runner
specialists.description: Executes the chosen experiment, behind a human approval gate.

specialists.name: analysis
specialists.description: Decides whether the result supports or breaks the hypothesis.

params.expression: (event.type == "tool_call" && (event.data.name.endsWith("run_experiment") || event.data.name.endsWith("test_hypothesis_on_unseen_chemistry"))) ? {"result": "ASK", "reason": "Spend assay budget: a scientist approves before the lab runs this experiment."} : {"result": "ALLOW"}

gate_effect: ASK: the call pauses until a person accepts or declines it
